FN-QNSTE54-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 394
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Kelvin Lawrence
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/10/2026
House Bill 394 as introduced would decrease sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust
Fund by approximately $7,360 annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, based on information
provided by the entity, by exempting Freedom Quilting Bee Legacy from paying state sales and
use taxes.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to counties and municipalities by
approximately $9,650 annually provided the respective local governments adopt an exemption
from local sales and use taxes, pursuant to this bill.
